name: Vocational Training For VJNT And SBC Candidates Studying In Government Industrial Training Institute
benefit: The training fees ₹ 400/- to ₹ 2400/- (as per course) are paid to the concerned I.T.I. After completion of training, one Tool Kit of ₹ 1000/- is provided to the trainee through the concerned Govt. I.T.I.
_eligibility_text:
1. Students should belong to VJNT or SBC Category.
1. The selection of students for training under this scheme is made by the Principal of the concerned Govt. I.T.I. & concerned Asstt.
1. Commissioner of Social Welfare.
